Name: EQUIP_PARAM_WEAPON_ST
Description:
Defines weapon types and each affinity.
Includes arrows and bolts. Responsible for scaling shown on certain consumables.
IDs not ending in a multiple of 100 are ignored.
Permitting affinities on a weapon without affinity rows at the correct IDs will result in the nearest 10000 being used.
SpEffects specified here can be modified by upgrades in ReinforceParamWeapon.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Picks the BehaviorParam rows of the weapon's attacks. Row = P x 100000000 + this x 1000 + J, where J is the last three digits of the animation's behavior judge ID and P is that ID / 1000 (1 when it is below 1000). If that row is missing (judge IDs of 1000 and up), the value rounded down to a multiple of 100 is tried. Values above 99999 are ignored.

Bonus = this x CalcCorrectGraph 160 (Dexterity) / 100 x (Dexterity - requirement) / (PlayerCommonParam guardStatusCorrect_MaxStatusVal - requirement), capped at the full value. Only when all stat requirements are met.

Fields.Name: Spell 1
Fields.Description: Spell (Magic) cast from the catalyst's first spell slot when the weapon carries no rolled spell for that slot (Custom Weapons roll theirs from Magic Table 1). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Spell 2
Fields.Description: Spell (Magic) cast from the catalyst's second spell slot when the weapon carries no rolled spell for that slot (Custom Weapons roll theirs from Magic Table 2). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Guard Poise Rate [%]
Fields.Description: The player-side value of the super-armour query that reads Poise Guard Cut Rate from NpcParam for enemies: the current weapon's value × 0.01 (0 without a weapon). How the poise code uses it is not established. Retail 0 on most weapons; 100 on test straight swords, 10 on Unarmed.

Fields.Name: Hit SFX Material Variation
Fields.Description: Used for a player's hit when the attack's Defense SFX Material Variation is 255 (use weapon): picks the hit effect material variation. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute Variation
Fields.Description: Special-attribute variation of the weapon's hits (for example red lightning), used when the attack takes its special attribute from the weapon (attack's Special Attribute 255). 0: default.

Fields.Name: Hit Rate Modifier
Fields.Description: Copied into the hit next to Critical Attack Rate as (100 + value) %; below 0 gives "none" (−1). Read for the player's weapon only; how the hit uses it is not established. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Skill Reroll Table
Fields.Description: SwordArtsTableParam table rolled for a new skill when Use Skill Table is set; the current skill is excluded from the roll. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Appearance Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be on for the weapon to be listed in the Sparring Grounds and the Visual Codex. 0 or −1: always listed. Retail: 6951 on two Scholar's Thrusting Sword rows.

Fields.Name: Hero Moveset Override
Fields.Description: Animation set used for this weapon in place of its own when the hero given in Hero ID wields it. 0: none. Retail: 269 + the hero's number (270 Wylder … 280 Undertaker).

Fields.Name: Hero ID
Fields.Description: Hero who uses Hero Moveset Override and Hero Behavior Variation ID with this weapon (1 Wylder, 2 Guardian, 3 Ironeye, 4 Duchess, 5 Raider, 6 Revenant, 7 Recluse, 8 Executor, 9 Scholar, 10 Undertaker). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Magic Cocktail Element
Fields.Description: Element the weapon's hits count as for elemental residue (10 Magic, 11 Fire, 12 Lightning, 13 Holy). 0: taken from the weapon's Special Attribute when that is Magic, Fire, Lightning or Holy, else none. Retail: 10 on Dark Moon Greatsword only.

Fields.Name: Hero Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Behavior variation used in place of the weapon's own when the hero given in Hero ID wields it (when a behavior row exists for the resulting ID). Values above 99999 are ignored. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Critical Damage Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the damage of the weapon's critical attacks (backstabs and ripostes). Retail: 1; daggers 1.3, Black Knife 1.1, Misericorde 1.4, up to 1.5.

Fields.Name: Fixed Attach Effect
Fields.Description: Attach effect (AttachEffectParam) every copy of the weapon carries; its SpEffects are added with the weapon's others. −1: none. Retail: the unique effects of Legendary and Unique weapons.

Fields.Name: Revive Damage
Fields.Description: Revive progress dealt to a downed ally per hit with this weapon, × the attack's Revive Damage % / 100. Retail: 14 or 20 on most weapons, 10 unarmed, 25 greatswords.

Fields.Name: Menu Reference Attack ID Override
Fields.Description: When 0 or more, the menus (item details and the character status screen) use this AtkParam ID as the weapon's reference attack when showing its values, instead of the one worked out from its behavior and bullet params. -1: work it out. Retail -1 on every row.
